    Point–brick data from a count of arrows and relations #

    Let F be a finite family of relations generating the relations of the cover of a piece. For a brick V vanishing at x, the extensions of V by the simple representation at x that respect the cover are the cocycles of F (crossOK_of_cocycle), and their dimension is at least Σ_{α → x} dim V(s α) - Σ_{ρ_r ending at x} dim V(s r) (Ext.finrank_data_le). If this number is at least 2, two independent extensions give the data of Bongartz's Lemma 4 (pointBrick_of_count).

    K.cross z le = FinQuiver.Ext.cross z le

    FinQuiver.Ext.crossA z (FinQuiver.word k D l) = FinQuiver.Ext.cross z l
